grounding.quote:
The Executive sequences delivery around a steel thread: the smallest real,
runnable path from a supported Product entry to a material outcome through
the selected composition.

concepts.label: Steel-thread delivery
concepts.definition: Profile-selected delivery strategy using the smallest real runnable supported-entry-to-material-outcome path through selected composition. Early end-to-end feedback trades against later widening; no superiority over other configurations' lawful strategies is claimed.

grounding.quote: | evaluation family | Can the exact authorised outcome be constructed through the smallest coherent causal cone while preserving every affected governing relation and disposing of competing paths? |

concepts.label: Derived Worker frame
concepts.definition: Finite Worker evaluation of whether the exact authorised outcome can be constructed through the smallest coherent causal cone while preserving every affected governing relation and disposing of competing paths. Its basis is sufficient ACTIVATION §1 intake and, where applicable, accepted design-to-execution basis. Its manifold includes affected entities, lifecycles, transformations, authorities, capabilities, algorithms, inputs, outputs, dependencies, interaction seams, failure boundaries and proof obligations. Coordinates bind activation, checkpoint, workspace, inputs, dependencies, configuration, actor envelope, outputs, candidate and evidence. Evidence includes live implementation, tests and their source, analysis, generated artifacts, claimed installed or operational behaviour, reconstruction, mutations and transition evidence. Required competence covers method, domain, implementation, tools, access and finite context.

grounding.quote: | evaluation family | Is this the exact claimed subject and basis? Does it satisfy the applicable method and project relations without competing authority, proof masking or an unevaluated composition boundary? For each finding, which evidence-bound severity and technical implications follow? |

concepts.label: Derived Reviewer frame
concepts.definition: Bounded Reviewer evaluation of exact claimed subject and basis, satisfaction of applicable method and project relations, competing authority, proof masking, composition boundaries, and evidence-bound severity and technical implications. Its intake includes candidate, claim, governing authorities, scope, exclusions, evidence population, Product-selected severity scale, review carrier and independence conditions. Its manifold includes causal producers and consumers, authority seams, competing paths, claimed failure/recovery/installed/reconstruction surfaces, test and fixture semantics, historical counterexamples and supportable technical triage. Coordinates include candidate, source basis, authority revision, configuration, dependency, evidence population, severity scale, installed subject, review time and Reviewer identity. Evidence is independently acquired from material live authority, implementation, tests, artifacts, history, operations, mutations, replay, reconstruction and reproduced observations. Competence includes method, domain, implementation, assurance, technical triage, tools, access, context, counterexample search and independence.

grounding.quote:
The Executive verifies that every consumed result is still bound to the
current subject and basis, revalidates the complete Product view and the
current MVP or release mandate, applies any declared result conjunction

concepts.label: Executive in the coordinated branch
concepts.definition: The profile's bounded assessor or proxy and decision owner: consumes closed results and technical triage against current Product and MVP or release mandates, assigns priority and promotion-boundary effect, and applies an existing disposition within its grant.

grounding.quote:
= candidate_ready(exact_subject, transition_evidence, residuals)
  | refused(reason, authority, evidence)
  | incomplete(residuals, evidence, stop_basis)
  | re_entry_requested(owner, material_relation, evidence)
each evaluation the Worker performed keeps its own core result

concepts.label: WorkerResult
concepts.definition: Exactly one closed Worker result: candidate_ready(exact_subject, transition_evidence, residuals), refused(reason, authority, evidence), incomplete(residuals, evidence, stop_basis), or re_entry_requested(owner, material_relation, evidence). The material relation in re_entry_requested includes its cause, authority or basis. Each variant maps to exactly one core value for the predicate 'a candidate is available'; individual Worker evaluations retain their own core results. The displayed notation is explanatory and mandates no schema.

grounding.quote:
If activation detects a known capability, authority, subject, basis or
topology mismatch, it returns `activation_refusal` directly to the
Executive

concepts.label: Activation refusal
concepts.definition: activation_refusal is returned by the activation relation directly to the Executive, with the cause and the core value assigned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5. No Worker frame is active and no Worker evaluation or Worker result exists for that failed activation.
conditions: Activation detects a known capability, authority, subject, basis or topology mismatch.

grounding.quote: The Reviewer returns one closed evaluation in the shape of EVALUATION §4,

concepts.label: Closed review result
concepts.definition: One closed Reviewer evaluation in the shape owned by EVALUATION §4: frame and activation identity; exact subject, basis, claim, scope, exclusions and evaluated population; Reviewer actor and independence; acquired evidence and ordinary assurance path; core result; findings, counterexamples and adjacent observations; supportable finding-level affected claim, severity, causal assessment and confidence, blast radius, workaround, repair complexity, regression risk and residual uncertainty; invalidation conditions and applicable re-entry owner. Its triage projects over the result algebra; a recommendation is evidence only.

grounding.quote:
The disposition
is the acceptance result; neither `candidate_ready` nor a satisfied review
result is acceptance

concepts.label: Disposition and acceptance result
concepts.definition: Exactly one authorised disposition: accept, local_repair, re_enter or reject. The disposition is the acceptance result; candidate_ready and a satisfied review are not acceptance. ACTIVATION §3 and §5 own disposition semantics, accepted checkpoint and next already-authorised bounded action.

grounding.quote:
Each
row is an evaluation archetype, not a complete frame declaration

concepts.label: Generic specialist frame families
concepts.definition: Twelve non-hierarchical, potentially overlapping evaluation archetypes in urn:stdo:bounded-context:reference-frame-evaluation, owned by REFERENCE_FRAME under the selected basis. They are not complete frame declarations, components, actors or runtime objects. Same-spelled Product, Owner, Entity, Operator, Install and other concepts in other contexts remain distinct.
conditions: The profile's generic set is adopted for Product work.

grounding.quote: Product and requirement authority keep meaning and acceptance.

concepts.label: Product evaluation family
concepts.definition: Evaluates whether one exact current Product claim, outcome, boundary and lifecycle govern the claimed subject without downstream reinterpretation, on current Intent, Product, requirements, acceptance meaning and exact Product coordinates. Product and requirement authorities retain meaning and acceptance; output is bounded evaluation and evidence.

grounding.quote: A chain is evaluated through bounded edge activations and a declared conjunction.

concepts.label: Product Composition
concepts.definition: Evaluates one exact directed Product relation, preserving source and target roles; Product Definition, Release Cut, Product and Install identities; Development Product role bindings; contracts, authority, lifecycle, evidence boundary and invalidation law. A chain uses bounded edge activations and declared conjunction. Each Product retains meaning; the authorities and contracts cited by the composition relation own the edge. Output is evaluation evidence only.

grounding.quote: The frame may identify satisfaction, contradiction or a design re-entry gap; it cannot invent Product truth.

concepts.label: Design
concepts.definition: Evaluates whether accepted structural HOW satisfies material constitutional WHAT, closes required design relations and preserves their owners across affected topology. Accepted design under governing Product and requirements owns structure. Outputs may identify satisfaction, contradiction or design re-entry gap, but cannot invent Product truth.

grounding.quote: Parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners keep their relations.

concepts.label: Design Component
concepts.definition: Evaluates one bounded design component and its direct causal dependency cone for preservation of parent contract, internal relations, sibling seams and required outputs. Its accepted boundary owns only its bounded composition decision; parent, sibling, Product, requirement and runtime owners retain their relations.

grounding.quote: it does not recreate interior semantics.

concepts.label: Public Boundary
concepts.definition: Evaluates whether a supported public entry or exit performs exactly its assigned validation, selection, transport, refusal and projection while preserving selected interior owners. Product, interface, identity, security and accepted-design authorities define it. Output is a closed evaluation of boundary result or refusal, without recreating interior semantics.

grounding.quote: The frame returns an identity- and lifecycle-bound evaluation.

concepts.label: Entity
concepts.definition: Evaluates one semantic, artifact or runtime entity's exact identity, kind, lifecycle, owner, representation and applicable effect regime. Product, domain, identity, requirement and accepted-design authorities define it; its result remains identity- and lifecycle-bound.

grounding.quote: The frame evaluates it without creating another executable plan.

concepts.label: Operator
concepts.definition: Evaluates whether one material operation is an irreducible declared relation over its admitted domain, inputs, outputs, refusals, algebra, effects and lawful compositions. Product, requirements, accepted ontology and design, and the named operation owner define it. Evaluation creates no additional executable plan.

grounding.quote: The frame may evaluate authority congruence only.

concepts.label: Owner
concepts.definition: Evaluates only authority congruence of one semantic or authority-bearing relation: owner, role kind, subject, scope, basis, lifecycle, refusal invariants and permitted delegation. Existing Product, requirement, identity, accepted-design, release or other named authority retains ownership.

grounding.quote: The frame returns an effect-bound result and evidence.

concepts.label: Effect
concepts.definition: Evaluates an action against its pure, observational, artifact or runtime effect regime, including material commit, failure, retry, recovery, compensation, admission and projection law. Applicable Product, requirement, design, artifact, runtime and admission owners retain decisions; output is effect-bound result and evidence.

grounding.quote: The frame cannot move semantic authority to a foundation.

concepts.label: Reuse/Foundation
concepts.definition: Evaluates normalisation and bounded comparison of a material generic capability or dependency against credible lawful foundations, preserving irreducible local remainder and authority-bearing role. Selection belongs to design-profile capability-and-foundation law and the existing trade-off owner; a foundation acquires no semantic authority.

grounding.quote: The frame returns installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence.

concepts.label: Install
concepts.definition: Evaluates exact selected Product, release, artifact, dependency set, configuration and callable entry through the admitted installed coordinate, independently of mutable source convenience. Product, identity, release, dependency, packaging and accepted-design authorities define the subject; output is installed identity, reachability and refusal evidence.

grounding.quote: The frame returns evidence and a closed evaluation result, not Product meaning or disposition.

concepts.label: Proof
concepts.definition: Evaluates congruence of one exact claim's subject, basis, path, population, oracle, evidence, falsifier, residual boundary and invalidation law. Claim owner defines meaning; testing, assurance, review, Product and release owners define evaluation and acceptance. Output is evidence and closed evaluation, never Product meaning or disposition.

grounding.quote:
Refinement opens only for a material
distinction needed to close the parent evaluation.

concepts.label: Recursive frame refinement
concepts.definition: A frame dependency relation opened only for a material distinction needed to close the parent evaluation. Each child records parent contract, purpose, material entities, identity and lifecycle relations, semantic owners, direct sibling seams, applicable invariants and prohibited competing paths. It is neither an organisational nor a runtime hierarchy.
conditions: A generic frame is recursively refined.

grounding.quote:
Coverage records the union of admissible observations the activated frames
contribute.

concepts.label: Coverage and composite claim
concepts.definition: Coverage is the union of admissible observations contributed by activated frames. A composite claim receives its declared conjunction's reported value. Every material cross-frame seam is mandatory result or required coverage, preserving or lawfully translating exact identity, coordinate, basis, value or evidence, lifecycle scope, authority and provenance.

grounding.quote:
user-acceptance, end-to-end,
integration and unit results keep their distinct claims and coordinates

concepts.label: Product testing frames
concepts.definition: ASSURANCE §7 user-acceptance, end-to-end, integration and unit testing frames supply claim-congruent evidence to one or more Proof evaluations while retaining distinct claims and coordinates. Proof supplies neither a testing hierarchy nor aggregate-green substitution.

grounding.quote:
Neither adds a thirteenth family, a fifth
testing type, a role or a universal activation gate

concepts.label: End-to-end interface integration
concepts.definition: ASSURANCE §13 end-to-end interface integration connects Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof families to integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames. Its computational whole-path evaluation composes selected interface claims with Operator, Owner, Reuse/Foundation and Proof. Neither introduces a thirteenth family, fifth testing type, role or universal activation gate.

grounding.quote:
Direct
Worker engagement keeps the same sufficient intake, work-result algebra,
closure conditions and owner boundaries

concepts.label: Coordinated and direct engagement
concepts.definition: The described transition sequence is the coordinated branch selected under §3. Direct Worker engagement retains the same sufficient intake, work-result algebra, closure conditions and owner boundaries without inserting an Executive appointment or review not required by an applicable condition.

grounding.quote:
The Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis
(PRODUCT_DEFINITION §7) projects that decision

concepts.label: Project Reference-Frame Basis
concepts.definition: Product-owned Project Reference-Frame Basis projects the outcome and work-authority decision selected under existing ownership by Goals, Product, requirements, accepted design, ticket, release law or an admitted bounded proxy. It cites every material configuration source without becoming a new local-axiom authority.

grounding.quote:
Every activation first carries the generic binding of REFERENCE_FRAME §11
(minimal activation binding).

concepts.label: Generic and frame-specific activation binding
concepts.definition: Bounded activation packet based on REFERENCE_FRAME §11. Worker activation additionally binds sufficient execution intake; Reviewer activation binds exact claim and assurance conditions; Executive activation binds current Product-role map, mandate, evaluation frontier, result and triage ledger, priority and boundary policy, conjunction and disposition grant.

grounding.quote:
the profile requires no new
artifact type

concepts.label: Handoff projections
concepts.definition: Bounded information projections for Worker activation, activation refusal, work result, Reviewer activation, review result, specialist activation, specialist result, and disposition/checkpoint. These projections preserve distinct producers, consumers, coordinates, minimum material content and owning laws; they require no new artifact type.

grounding.quote:
The Executive derives the complete known evaluation inventory from the
selected method members, the project domain, the outcome, history,
dependencies and the workspace.

concepts.label: Known evaluation inventory and coverage
concepts.definition: Known evaluation inventory derived by the Executive from selected method members, project domain, outcome, history, dependencies and workspace. Engagement frames organise finite specialist evaluations; they do not contain the complete Product or workspace. Operational full coverage retains unknown, uncovered, conditional, conflicted and authority-excluded residuals.

grounding.quote: in that order, all of them. This profile adds two readings and no question

concepts.label: Missing-frame diagnosis and re-entry
concepts.definition: Bounded missing-frame diagnosis accepts closed out_of_frame, indeterminate or invalid_basis results identifying the missing relation, coordinate, evidence, authority, capability or interaction that can change evaluation. The Executive applies all eight REFERENCE_FRAME §10 diagnostic questions in order before adding or revising a frame.

grounding.quote: Two relations stay apart here.

concepts.label: Profile adoption and configuration admission
concepts.definition: Optional executive profile configuration. Product adoption and admission of the configuration's material decisions are separate relations: method-cut inclusion makes the profile available; Product authority adopts it; the smallest existing authority owning each material decision admits that decision's configuration.

grounding.quote: A baseline-adoption projection records inside that Product-owned basis

concepts.label: Baseline-adoption projection
concepts.definition: Adoption projection within the Product-owned basis, recording exact complete method, REFERENCE_FRAME and profile identities; admitting authority; workspace, Product scope, outcome, basis and time; local role capability envelopes and actor-binding rules; twelve-family declarations/acquisition paths or authority-bound non-material or explicit residual dispositions; specialist declarations/acquisition; material testing declarations, claims, ordinary paths, combination populations, scenario matrix, oracles and forbidden paths; subject/evidence/checkpoint/review coordinates; coverage ledger and accepted residual boundary; invalidation and frame-set revision conditions.

grounding.quote:
A project may define different frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor
bindings.

concepts.label: Project-defined configuration
concepts.definition: Project-defined allocation of frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor bindings under defining Product, requirement, Goals or accepted-design authority. Its record contains exact method/project basis, evaluation inventory, frame declarations and capability, semantic/evaluation/material-operation/decision authority, intentional overlap and separately activated evaluations, required independence, actual conjunction/translation/composition, allocation explanation with resource limits and failure assumptions, obligation mappings, coverage and residual uncertainty, re-entry, invalidation and revision.

grounding.quote: # Executive Baseline Adoption Additions

concepts.label: Executive Baseline Adoption Additions template
concepts.definition: Profile-specific template additions to the Product Definition §7 basis and §16 adoption record: profile identity; role declarations or acquisition references; role capability, authority and independence bindings; Product-selected severity and priority scales, cutoff, hard stops and triage relation; referenced work-to-core mapping and each refinement's parent core value; twelve-family dispositions; testing claims, topology, populations, scenario matrix, oracles and required/forbidden authoritative paths; activation refusal, closed-result, conjunction and return relations; qualification evidence and residuals.

grounding.quote:
A valid pure-method trial does not prove this profile, and a
valid profile trial does not prove the method's complete function
population

concepts.label: Profile qualification
concepts.definition: Qualification of the profile and its declared composition with exact REFERENCE_FRAME basis through EVALUATION §7 frame qualification and method self-qualification. No new protocol or peer authority is created. Pure-method trials do not prove this profile; profile trials do not prove the complete method function population. Claims are limited to evaluated frame revisions, actor envelopes, result branches and evidence populations.

grounding.quote: The table routes evaluation; it does not predetermine a verdict

concepts.label: Failure classification
concepts.definition: Observation-to-first-diagnosis routing table. Its classifications guide evaluation and do not predetermine verdicts.

grounding.quote:
a closed
`indeterminate` result or a review event does not satisfy an unresolved
obligation

concepts.label: Applicable condition-based closure
concepts.definition: Condition-based closure owned by TICKETS §7, applied to the selected branch. Available frames and testing families do not by themselves make claims applicable. A review event or closed indeterminate result cannot satisfy an unresolved obligation; indeterminate never maps to satisfied. A project-defined configuration may close against REFERENCE_FRAME, complete selected method and existing project authorities without claiming this optional profile.
conditions: An exact selected outcome and engagement branch determine applicability.

grounding.quote: Tier 1. Owns the vocabulary of standing (§1);

concepts.label: FOUNDATIONS subject document
concepts.definition: Subject document described as Tier 1 owner of standing vocabulary; ontology, frame, authority, lineage and work-boundary objects; construction accounts and imports; commitments P0–P6 and foundation-to-law traces; composition, conservation, core result and conjunction algebras; categorical demonstration requirements; and hypotheses. Other members import or refine these definitions.

grounding.quote: Each has exactly one of four standings:

concepts.label: Foundational claim standing
concepts.definition: Each foundational claim, whether commitment or hypothesis, has exactly one standing: recovered is an adopted premise consolidating named source rules without treating them as proof; independent is an adopted premise argued by a case where other commitments hold and it fails; derived is a consequence with named premises; hypothesis is unestablished by the method, not law, and held for falsification. This differs from result standing and successor disposition.

grounding.quote:
An
unqualified "join" in a result context means the join of results

concepts.label: Four context-dependent meanings of join
concepts.definition: Four distinct uses of join: categorical join is a map between categories; composition boundary joins successive steps; join of results combines closed results under one decision rule; relation join is equality join of participants in an enclosing relation. Unqualified join in a result context means join of results.

grounding.quote: | Subject | the thing a claim, representation or transformation is about; exact, with inventory and bytes or semantic addresses | P3 |

concepts.label: Foundational ontology objects
concepts.definition: Ontology categories: Subject is the exact thing a claim, representation or transformation concerns, identified by inventory and bytes or semantic addresses. Representation is bytes, text, model or program standing for a subject. Interpretation is a declared context-bound representation-to-meaning contract identifying reliable distinctions and residuals. Context declares subject, definitions, basis and admissible observations. Outcome U is an owner-selected directly verifiable state with acceptance interval. Object O has scoped identity (authority, kind, value), boundary, state and material relations. Actor performs a step within context, attention, time and capability limits; role is an occupied relation selected by configuration. Step is bounded intake, selected context, grant, execution and output. Step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision that cannot be reacquired from declared sources; reproducible observations are excluded. Claim binds subject, property, basis, witness relation and falsifier. Evidence comprises admitted exact observations/artifacts with provenance, subject identity, basis and scope. Judgment is recorded evaluation over unchanged subject, with evaluator, decision, evidence, scope and revising observation. Authority is identity-bearing scoped permission to operate or dispose acceptance. Residual is material uncertainty, omission, loss or unproven relation awaiting authorised disposition. Basis is every exact version, identity, time, topology, authority, configuration or evidence coordinate whose change can alter the bound step, claim, result or evaluation. Materiality is evaluation-relative potential to change result, basis validity, admissible evidence, operation performer or decision owner, including uncertainty and closure.

grounding.quote:
The reference frame and the objects it binds are first-class in this
corpus.

concepts.label: Reference-frame ontology
concepts.definition: Frame objects: Evaluation is a declared question with known result family, evidence basis, decision authority and material-operation authority where needed, admitting judgment, prediction, construction, comparison, proof, refusal, classification or action recommendation. Evaluation family shares required manifold, authority basis and result algebra. Workspace is bounded reasoned-over or acted-on material, potentially broader than a repository. Material-relation manifold is the finite jointly interpretable variables, entities, identities, states, relations, invariants, authorities, observations and exclusions needed by a family, allowing overlapping coordinate charts without implied geometry or runtime. Coordinate is complete locally required basis, identity, lineage, input, evidence and authority information. Topology is the material relation structure visible at one basis, not necessarily complete workspace topology. Capability envelope is required competence, context capacity, tools, access, independence and configuration. Reference frame specifies finite attention, coordinates, authority, evidence and result relations for a family and basis. Activated frame binds declaration to exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary. Frame set is a human-declared available family permitting overlaps, alternatives, specialists, exploration and separate assurance. Active frame configuration is activations and declared result relations for one evaluation or decision. Lens is a reusable question family, becoming a frame only on full bounded instantiation. Role allocates responsibility/authority; persona changes approach/salience; abstraction hides/contracts detail; component is structural. None is a frame merely by identity.

grounding.quote:
These may coincide in a lawful case and
never collapse by default.

concepts.label: Authority kinds and actor identity
concepts.definition: Distinct kinds: frame-set authority is human declaration/acceptance of a project frame set; semantic authority owns meaning of a material relation; evaluation authority permits evaluation; operation authority is an owner-issued grant to construct, transform, admit, publish or mutate a material subject; decision authority permits accepting, rejecting or otherwise disposing results. Actor identity identifies the human, agent, tool or process and is not authority. These may lawfully coincide but never collapse by default.

grounding.quote: Three relations stay distinct

concepts.label: Disjointness, evaluation independence and assurance independence
concepts.definition: Frame disjointness is structural absence of shared material variable, coordinate, evidence or result dependency for declared evaluations. Evaluation independence is procedural separation of activations that neither consume nor influence one another's unclosed working results; they may share subject or manifold and later contribute closed results to one conjunction. Assurance independence is claim-relative separation prescribed by assurance law, including non-authorship, acquisition, exposure, actor and configuration conditions. Disjointness does not imply independent evaluation, independent activation does not imply disjointness, and the unqualified word independent establishes none of the three.

grounding.quote: A reference frame F is the tuple ⟨Q, B, M, C, I, A, E, X, R, J, K, D⟩

concepts.label: Frame tuple
concepts.definition: Reference frame F = ⟨Q, B, M, C, I, A, E, X, R, J, K, D⟩: evaluation family; workspace/topology basis; manifold; coordinate/equality law; invariants; authority; evidence/provenance law; exclusions/prohibited assumptions; closed core result algebra or mapped refinement; invalidation/rechart condition; capability envelope; optional declared dependencies, overlaps, inputs and outputs. This relation is an evaluation contract, not a required schema/runtime carrier. Prompt, context packet, symbolic program or other representation projects an activated frame rather than being the frame.

grounding.quote:
Each role is an
object with its own identity

concepts.label: Recursive product taxonomy and release neighbours
concepts.definition: Distinct identities in FOUNDATIONS-owned urn:stdo:bounded-context:recursive-product-taxonomy, with corresponding urn:stdo:concept:recursive-product-taxonomy:<name> identities: substrate is a lower product/runtime used to build products; development-product is the role of one exact released-product install acting as builder for a source project, creating no new Product identity or authority transfer; source-project is mutable workspace building the next release cut; release-cut is immutable annotated candidate boundary over a published feature set; product is the immutable released thing after cut acceptance; install is a stamped workspace instance; artifact is published output built by a source project or configured install; product-definition is present-tense source-project WHAT authority, conventionally PRODUCT.md, not released artifact. Separate release neighbours are candidate source, a mutable successor-building state non-operative for released consumers; release subject, the exact member set/artifact bound by cut-scoped claims; and version-line selector, a mutable alias for the highest-ordinal published cut on one project's version line, useful for discovery but insufficient as exact immutable basis.

grounding.quote:
the
live specification and design should declare

concepts.label: Declared work boundary
concepts.definition: Boundary object around a probabilistic, agentic or delegated work unit. Live specification and design should declare six parts: input/output contract; required context; capability/role expectation; admissible evidence/evaluator regime; provenance obligation; lawful stop, hold, gap, continuation or completion states. ACTIVATION §1 makes this unit's intake, context and result algebra exact.

grounding.quote:
This section owns the distinction as an added
choice in the sense of §3 Foundation to law, not a commitment;

concepts.label: Three accounts of construction
concepts.definition: Construction realises a selected outer contract through steps. Three independently variable accounts remain distinct: algorithmic description of steps; informational interpretation of data under an Interpretation contract; computational realisation by people, machines or mixtures in a declared execution environment, with build-tenant environment owned by SPEC_METHOD §11. A construction may need all three; none is a corpus tier. This distinction is an added choice, not a commitment, and has none of the foundational claim standings.

grounding.quote:
An import is
reference-only. Source and target meanings are identical owner-qualified
references, not new local definitions.

concepts.label: Import and adoption between members
concepts.definition: Reference-only import carries identical owner-qualified meaning from named source to importing context, with no loss, translation, ownership transfer or authority. It takes either a collected declaration or a point-of-use reference naming the owning section. Adoption is the target's use of an imported concept under source-owned adoption premises; lifecycle remains source-owned.

grounding.quote: | P4b Conservation of step-produced facts | derived from P0 and P2, with P0's premise that step-produced facts are not re-acquirable | sources a later step can re-acquire are governed by sufficiency, not conservation |

concepts.label: P0–P6 commitments
concepts.definition: P0 Bounded construction is recovered: finite actors realise selected outer contracts through fitting steps, owning their internal path; actors may change and reacquire declared sources but not private memory, step-produced facts are not reacquirable, the world is open and output is candidate until evaluated. P1 Interpretation is independent: subject, representation and context-bound meaning differ; structural success is not fidelity and semantic decisions require exact contracts. P2 Purpose is independent: selected outcome defines adequacy and interface obligations derive from the served transformation. P3 Identity is independent: declared authority/kind/value identity survives admissible change and boundaries carry proof obligations. P4a Typed composition is independent: prior type and judgment must satisfy the next exact domain and preconditions, retaining identities, intermediate results, judgments, evidence, authority, provenance and stop states. P4b Conservation is derived from P0 and P2 plus non-reacquirability: producing steps record outer-contract-needed judgments, residuals, observations and authority decisions; reacquirable sources follow sufficiency rather than conservation. P5 Totality is derived from P0 and P6 plus open-world premise: no success on outside-context conditions, first-class non-success and named next moves. P6 Justification and authority is independent: definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports basis-bound claims and authority permits or disposes only within scope.

grounding.quote:
It is derived, not a further
commitment, and has the standing of a consequence

concepts.label: Construction synthesis
concepts.definition: Derived consequence synthesising commitments for movement from observed current state to acceptable destination under finite resources; not a further commitment. P0 bounds acquisition/work and preserves internal strategy; P1 preserves comparison meaning among conditions, observations and predictions; P2 selects destination Z and adequacy criteria; P3 separates persistent subject, observations and dependencies from accounts; P4a carries obligations through steps/refinement/boundaries; P4b conserves non-reacquirable facts through observation/correction/reuse; P5 accounts for resource tradeoffs, recursion, recovery and truthful undecided stops; P6 establishes support and authority without minting either. ACTIVATION §1 owns the construction relation.

grounding.quote:
the product testing frames of ASSURANCE §7 supply
claim-congruent evidence to one or more Proof evaluations

relations.meaning: Distinct testing claims and coordinates supply evidence to one or more Proof evaluations without establishing hierarchy or acceptance.

grounding.quote:
relates the
Public Boundary, Design, Operator, Owner and Proof families to the
integration, end-to-end and user-acceptance frames.

relations.meaning: Connects the named specialist families with integration, end-to-end and UAT testing; whole-path evaluation additionally composes Reuse/Foundation. Connectivity itself creates no authority.

grounding.quote: In the coordinated branch the Executive applies `activate`

relations.meaning: Source-defined Executive-to-Worker activation uses the inherited packet and grant; this relation describes no actual activation.
conditions: Coordinated branch; sufficient execution intake and existing bounded authorisation.
exceptions: Known mismatch yields activation_refusal; no Worker activation or evaluation results.

grounding.quote:
Every coordinated Worker activation ends in one closed work result sent to
the Executive;

relations.meaning: Worker sends exactly one closed work result to Executive and stops, without activating Reviewer.
exceptions: Direct work returns to its declared result consumer.

grounding.quote: When independent review is required, the Executive activates the Reviewer

relations.meaning: Executive, rather than Worker, supplies required exact-subject independent-review activation.
conditions: Independent review is required under applicable governing conditions.

grounding.quote: Reviewer returns to the Executive, not to the Worker

relations.meaning: Reviewer returns evaluation and evidence-bound triage to Executive, with no disposition or continuation authorisation.

grounding.quote:
where an item appears in both, the
§16 statement decides it

relations.meaning: The §16 adoption statement decides duplicated content in the §19 additions; together they constitute one record.
conditions: An item appears in both adoption and additions lists.

grounding.quote:
a synthesis
of their relations

relations.meaning: The source explicitly grounds construction synthesis in the commitments, without adding a commitment or proving reachability, stability, optimality or termination.
conditions: The supplied synthesis is read as a consequence of the stated commitments.

grounding.quote:
Each passing thread establishes only the relations and
conditions actually exercised; untested branches, interaction combinations,
and refusal and recovery paths keep their material proof obligations.
Settled construction decisions are revisited when material counterevidence
invalidates their basis (P6, P4b).

constraints.statement: Establish the runnable thread early and widen in bounded increments selected for consequential uncertainty, dependency/interface reach and failure impact. Early end-to-end/integration evidence prunes incompatible choices and settles exercised interfaces only; untested branches/combinations/refusal/recovery paths retain proof obligations and material counterevidence reopens settled decisions. During construction use focused deterministic regressions and targeted judgment probes for material uncertainty and unit evidence for module-owned laws. Schedule substantial resource-intensive user-acceptance cycles near release or when bounded capability is sufficiently complete to qualify. Distinct testing claims govern scenarios, independent assessments and repetitions. Reuse qualified results while exact subject/basis remain valid, rerun affected assurance upon invalidation, and activate construction only under existing mandate and operation grants.
conditions: The executive profile's delivery strategy applies.
exceptions: An existing affected thread is extended or revalidated; early focused user probes remain appropriate when they decide material outcome uncertainty.

grounding.quote:
missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory
mutation authority refuses the effect
| invalidation | a material change of intake, basis, checkpoint, dependency, configuration, capability or topology |

constraints.statement: Worker construction/transformation and self-review authority is inherited and bounded by the complete selected method/project relations material to the cone; ACTIVATION §1 owns construction/self-review. Mutation requires the exact owner grant naming subject and write territory; role label gives no authority and missing, ambiguous or out-of-territory authority refuses the effect. No admission, publication, independent acceptance, frame-set revision, inferred next action, upstream semantic change, unauthorised cone expansion, self-acceptance, hidden competing path or advance after result return is permitted. candidate_ready binds exact candidate and ACTIVATION §7 transition evidence, never accept. Green tests evidence only relations actually exercised by production/test semantics. Material change in intake, basis, checkpoint, dependency, configuration, capability or topology invalidates the frame.
constraints.uncertainty: External ACTIVATION and EVALUATION details are referenced, not supplied.

grounding.quote:
It
creates no second verdict or disposition family
| authority | bounded evaluation only; review access yields no construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, decision, disposition or next-activation authority |

constraints.statement: Reviewer authority is evaluation only: no editing, repair implementation, construction, transformation, admission, publication, mutation, priority, release/MVP disposition, decision, next action or activation. It cannot substitute Worker summary, reconstruct assurance-owned semantics, flatten unbound evidence or silently expand scope. It returns one core result with findings, counterexamples, evidence-bound triage and residuals sufficient for Executive priority/disposition where decidable. Governing invariants are RF-001–RF-017, ACTIVATION §1/§3, EVALUATION §1/§3/§7 and applicable Product/design/identity/release law. TICKETS UP-007 and governing basis determine review requirement and traceability; EVALUATION §3 determines independence and §1/§3/§7 assurance/freeze. The profile adds no universal review or independence test and no second verdict/disposition family; ACTIVATION retains assessment/disposition ownership. Material changes in candidate, authority, basis, evidence population, severity scale, dependency, configuration, scope or independence invalidate review.
constraints.uncertainty: The imported RF rules and governing assurance laws are unavailable in full.

grounding.quote:
Each finding binds a violated property, a supported entry or state, the
governing operating or threat model and a credible causal path.

constraints.statement: Each finding binds violated property, supported entry/state, governing operating/threat model and credible causal path; retained guards and acceptance predicates obey the same conditions. Excluded threat alone supports no retention claim; wider threat-model proposals re-enter their owner. Internal location alone does not establish trust, hypothetical hostility alone does not establish applicability, and required actual untrusted-input, mutable-state, authority and effect checks remain. Suggested repair becomes obligation only through its proper owner. Tests enter the manifold when code, fixtures, mutation, environment or interpretation can change the proof claim; passing results cannot replace semantic review. Unsupported cause, blast radius, workaround or repair risk is recorded as uncertainty, not manufactured complete triage.
conditions: A finding, retained guard or acceptance predicate is evaluated.

grounding.quote:
An adopting project binds, for every activated
instance, the exact subject, basis, material manifold, coordinates,
invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability
envelope, dependencies and invalidation conditions

constraints.statement: Every activated instance binds exact subject, basis, manifold, coordinates, invariants, authority, evidence, exclusions, result algebra, capability envelope, dependencies and invalidation. Every material cross-context seam requires an explicit relation. Topology gives Product no rank over Design; existing Product authority already owns constitutional meaning. A broader Owner frame gains no authority over Entity or Operator, and Proof gains no Reviewer, acceptance or disposition authority. The existing authority graph governs.

grounding.quote: | Family | Evaluation family and exact subject | Governing authority and permitted output | Immediate falsifier |

constraints.statement: Immediate falsifiers are family-specific. Product: downstream design/code/tests/predecessor behaviour/local convention changes meaning or substitutes subject. Product Composition: nesting, shared code/actor, import, tool reachability, equal output or builder convenience creates/changes a relation; builder is confused with authored Product; one node silently redefines another. Design: implementation precedent resolves open material design, design creates Product meaning, or material relation/competing structure is undeclared. Design Component: omitted far-side seam, absorbed parent/sibling decision, or local closure while direct composition is unresolved. Public Boundary: interpreting owner meaning, hidden domain sequencing, projecting interior carrier as Product truth, or unsupported admission. Entity: filename/wrapper/ticket/shape/cache/process substitutes identity or lifecycle coordinates collapse. Operator: endpoint/function/class/command/file labels substitute semantic atom, orchestration hides operator, or generic mechanics become domain law. Owner: rival judgment, authorship-as-transfer, or widened proxy/foundation/frame/actor grant. Effect: collapsed regimes, bypassed mutation owner, compensation-as-semantic-rollback, or read-as-rival-writable-truth. Reuse/Foundation: incumbent/local selection without bounded comparison, reproducing richer lawful foundation, favourably scoring unknowns, or reuse acquiring authority. Install: source imports, ambient resolution, registries, fixtures, rebuilds or moving workspace substitute installed subject. Proof: harness recreates meaning, evidence targets foreign subject/path, counts/aggregate green substitute claim, or proof tooling mutates subject undetectably.

constraints.statement: The known evaluation inventory disposes every family as material and instantiated by one or more exact declarations or authoritative acquisition paths; evidenced non-material to the exact outcome by capable authority; or explicit uncovered, conditional, conflicted or out_of_frame residual. Evaluated failure to preserve/translate yields falsified or the cause-specific refused-translation outcome/core value owned by REFERENCE_FRAME §5. Undecidable evidence yields indeterminate; an undeclared necessary translation/relation yields out_of_frame; evaluation on stale, advanced, ambiguous or mismatched basis yields its own invalid_basis returned result. Any such case forbids satisfied for the composite; gaps remain recorded by kind. None of these variants is accepted progress
because work occurred

Self-review stays Worker

Where EVALUATION §7 requires it, the candidate is frozen before material

The

Goals/admitted work authority own bounded work selection; Product owns Product-wide capability/acceptance meaning; requirements own constitutional behaviour; accepted design owns realisation structure and specialist design frames; identity/release owners retain declared decisions; explicitly bounded proxies remain within existing grants. its authority is the cited Goals, Product, requirement or

the Reviewer is not the author of that subject,

grounding.quote:
A
refinement names its owner here and never redefines it; a refinement of
results maps each of its values into the core

A premise is
never presented as derived, and a hypothesis never as law

constraints.statement: Imported definitions are not redefined; refinements name their FOUNDATIONS owner and each refined result value maps into core. Recovered and independent commitments are adopted premises, derived commitments their consequences; premise cannot be presented as derived and hypothesis cannot be law. Foundational standing, result standing and successor disposition remain distinct. Every clause names its requiring principle P0–P6.

grounding.quote: mixed bases need an explicit composite relation
actor capability may justify a different frame size or activation sequence and can neither waive an invariant nor widen authority
representation cannot create, widen or replace it

constraints.statement: Equal representations do not establish equal meaning; object identity survives admissible state/encoding changes. Evidence availability creates neither semantic truth nor decision authority. Basis is immutable or has declared advancement detection and reevaluation conditions; mixed bases require explicit composition. Similar wording does not prove equal evaluation family, and equal names/values/shapes/locations/topological positions do not prove coordinate equality. Topology is preserved only if all material entities, relations, lifecycle spaces, authorities, capabilities, adjacencies and seams are preserved; changing any is topology mutation that may invalidate coordinates. Capability may change frame size/sequence but cannot waive invariants or widen authority. Declaration reuse does not prove activation correctness. Frame binding requires every material coordinate to resolve to exact source, subject, basis, authority, evidence route, actor envelope, result relation and invalidation condition; source-linked prose suffices and representation cannot create/widen/replace binding.

grounding.quote:
Authority of any kind exists only by an
admitted grant or an explicit authority decision of its owner, with an
identifiable basis.

constraints.statement: Authority requires admitted grant or explicit owner decision on identifiable basis. Read-only evaluation declares no operation authority; effectful evaluation inherits exact owner grant rather than frame-created authority. Identity/capability/tools/access; names, labels, roles, capability strings, locators/paths; declaring/selecting/activating/executing frames or occupying roles; implementation reachability; evidence/payload shape or availability; checks/success/review/counts; copying/interpreting/encoding/evaluating/transporting/projecting/compressing/importing/acquiring; work-contract drafting/admission/retention beyond admitted contents; and composition/delegation/adapters/wrappers/registries create, widen, transfer or reconstruct no semantic/evaluation/operation/decision authority. The latter mechanisms may restrict or faithfully carry grants but cannot widen scope, add role, increase cardinality or change kind. Elevation, transfer, split, merge, proxy grant, revocation and retirement each require explicit authority decision and identifiable basis. Domain instances cite the shared rule rather than mint variants.

grounding.quote: A proxy acts only inside its existing grant.

constraints.statement: Proxy must be explicitly admitted, bounded and permitted by governing identity/authority law; proxy and human identities remain distinct. It cannot change outcome meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design: those re-enter owning relations. Proxy grants do not make constructor self-review independent, create unrelated runtime/domain authority or replace required direct human acceptance. IDENTITY §6 owns grant contents and ACTIVATION §1 owns allowable within-step decisions.
constraints.uncertainty: Grant-content and within-step decision laws are not supplied.
conditions: A human authority acts through a proxy.
exceptions: Direct human acceptance remains required wherever governing Product or release law requires it.

grounding.quote:
Equal version text does not collapse these objects. A selector or a
mutable carrier may move; a release cut never moves.

constraints.statement: Do not call mutable source workspace a Product or confuse source project with immutable release cut/install. Builder role binds exact install without transferring meaning/authority or confusing authored Product. Product definition remains source authority rather than released artifact. Products may depend on products; installs may build successors or other products, as in bootstrap source→release P0→install P0→build P1 source→release P1. Candidate source, release subject, selector and cut remain distinct; co-location does not establish release membership and equal version text establishes no identity equality. Selectors/carriers may move, cuts never do.
constraints.uncertainty: SPEC_METHOD §6 and RELEASE §1/§2 applications and exact selector rules are external.

grounding.quote:
a missing
source meaning, adoption or authority binding is an undeclared material
relation, the ground of `out_of_frame`

constraints.statement: Use requires reference-only import, not redefinition. For each concept identify owner's name, owning textual section (not itself semantic authority), declared source bounded context or source member if none, target context/member, source→target direction and no loss. A collected declaration or point-of-use owning-section reference supplies these facts; proximity/equal spelling never imports. Changed, narrowed or lossy meaning is not import. Activation binds distinct member coordinates even under the same selected cut. Changes in member, basis, source declaration or adoption premise require fresh applicability. Missing source meaning, adoption or authority binding is reported before dependent reliance; dependent evaluation has out_of_frame ground. Changed member/basis with applicability unestablished has invalid_basis ground.
constraints.uncertainty: Full result algebra and external adoption laws are not supplied; the stated grounds remain distinct.
conditions: A member uses another member's defined concept.

grounding.quote: not theorems derived from finite capacity alone

constraints.statement: Each commitment has exactly its stated standing; adopted domain premises are not derived from finite actor capacity. Particular rules need premises plus owned domain/policy choices; arguments create no authority. P0 deterministic checks/validation are evidence surfaces and may optimise/prove precise domain-local paths, but do not authorise framework/runtime absorption of domain strategy into constitutional law. Unconstrained probabilistic reasoning stays worker-internal and returns through boundary contracts, evidence, provenance and control truth. Prescribing strategy beyond that contract crosses authority. Profiles may bind the unit to a traversal unit as admissible external space under PROFILES §2. P4b records required non-reacquirable facts at their producing step, including authority, residual, judgment, frame-boundary, transition, successor-claim and referenced-evidence instances scoped by consumers. P5's named indeterminate/out_of_frame/invalid_basis values are declared result-family choices, not uniquely derived names.
constraints.uncertainty: External profiles, result family F3 and calculus applications are referenced only.
exceptions: A Product may explicitly promote internal HOW into declared reusable structure within its authority.

grounding.quote:
Feedback, a useful model and
locally valid steps do not by themselves prove reachability, stability,
optimality or termination

constraints.statement: Finite capacity motivates bounded work while purpose, meaning, identity, compatibility, evidence and authority retain independent premises. Strategy selection and domain controls are owned added choices. Feedback, a useful model and locally valid steps alone prove neither reachability, stability, optimality nor termination.

grounding.quote:
Read scope follows the complete causal cone and may exceed write territory
within the declared access grant.

allowed: Inspect the complete causal cone, potentially beyond write territory, within declared access grant.
Return a needed out-of-territory repair to its owner.
forbidden: Use narrow mutation grant to omit a material producer, consumer or governing owner from inspection.
Infer cross-boundary effects from understanding a relation.

grounding.quote:
The Reviewer may assess likely repair complexity and regression risk
without becoming the repair owner.

allowed: Assess likely repair complexity and regression risk without becoming repair owner.
Record uncertainty when cause, blast radius, workaround or repair risk cannot be supported within activation.
forbidden: Turn suggested repair into obligation without its proper owner.

grounding.quote: The families are non-hierarchical and may overlap

forbidden: Infer frame hierarchy or authority transfer from breadth or topology.
Treat Proof as Reviewer, acceptance or disposition authority.

allowed: Consumers may declare material consumer-specific frames under their own Product or accepted-design authority.
forbidden: Import consumer-specific frames, runtime roles, architectural topology or renamed local substitutes into the baseline set.
Select a dominant frame as this profile's conjunction choice.

allowed: Carry bounded projections as fields in existing Goals, tickets, design assets, commentary, qualification, release evidence or other admitted carriers.
forbidden: Infer relations merely by flattening different candidates, processes, episodes, configurations, populations or bases.

grounding.quote:
A project configuration need not keep the labels Executive, Worker and
Reviewer or map one local frame to each.

allowed: Define different frames, names, overlaps, sequences and actor bindings under existing owning authority.
Omit Executive/Worker/Reviewer labels and one-local-frame-per-label mapping.
Carry accepted configuration in a local axioms document.
forbidden: Lose applicable method relations or claim coverage.
Derive authority from document category or evaluate configuration solely by labels/topology/difference from baseline.

grounding.quote:
one actor may occupy several frames across
different activations where authority and any claimed independence are
preserved.

allowed: One actor may occupy several frames across different activations where authority and claimed independence are preserved.
Humans, agents, deterministic tools or mixed configurations may occupy frames.
Executive may inspect a subject to adjudicate a result.
forbidden: Count fresh author context as non-authorship or Executive tool use as an independent review result.

grounding.quote: it is not required to be a partition, tree, stack or exhaustive ontology

allowed: Frame sets may contain intentional overlaps, alternatives, specialists, broad exploration and separately activated assurance.
Configurations may contain one or several disjoint, overlapping or composed frames.
One component may occur in several frames and one frame may cross components.
forbidden: Require a frame set to be a partition, tree, stack or exhaustive ontology.
Treat role, persona, abstraction or component as a reference frame by identity alone.

grounding.quote:
The worker, tool, agent
or domain implementation owns the internal HOW inside that boundary unless
the product explicitly promotes part of that HOW into reusable declared
structure.

allowed: Worker, tool, agent or domain implementation owns internal HOW within the declared boundary, unless Product explicitly promotes part into reusable declared structure.
forbidden: Treat governance of work boundary as absorption of internal solution strategy into framework.

are returned is the conjunction rule the adopting project declares

residuals.consequence: Retain all supplied seam cases and their non-satisfaction boundaries without choosing a missing precedence rule or cause-specific translation result.

Each value maps to exactly one core value for "a candidate is

residuals.consequence: Preserve one-to-one variant-to-core cardinality and lawful-activation condition, but do not assign specific core values to variants.

grounding.quote:
any other finding meeting one of that section's
four conditions

residuals.uncertainty: The four EVALUATION §5 conditions are referenced but not stated; §8 exclusions and complete EVALUATION §4 triage projection are also absent.
residuals.consequence: No complete promotion decision procedure or threshold is fabricated. Preserve current mandate, cutoff, hard-stop inputs and explicit indeterminate alternative.

a sufficient direct local case starts and finishes as Writer in its
   existing carrier

residuals.uncertainty: Writer appears without a supplied definition; nearby and other direct-engagement clauses use Worker. Whether this is distinct terminology or an editorial inconsistency is unresolved.
residuals.consequence: Retain the literal Writer wording in the trial requirement; do not silently rename it or declare an additional role.

residuals.consequence: Interpret supplied applicability and non-satisfaction conditions without asserting a work item closes or providing a reconstructed external closure predicate.
